Due to a legal issue, Yan was helped by Carol Danvers.
Priscilla Davis was diagnosed with a congenital heart defect which she kept secret, not wanting her loved ones to watch her dying for months.
Proxima Midnight, like the rest of the Black Order, was a member of a world conquered by Thanos in his quest to wipe out half the universe.
In the aftermath of the fight in Central Park, Castle had then been taken back into custody by Homeland Security and spent the next three days in Sacred Saints Hospital.

Still furiously beating down the walls with his sledgehammer, Castle kept on working late on his shift, while Lance and his friends tease him as they walk past him before going to Murphy's for a drink.

Without knowing about the link between Operation Cerberus and the Massacre at Central Park, Castle targeted the three gangs that were involved in the firefight at the park – the Kitchen Irish, the Dogs of Hell, and the Mexican Cartel.

During one of his unit's deployments within Afghanistan, Castle was assigned to a new task force under the supervision of Ray Schoonover and an anonymous civilian commander known to the men only as Agent Orange.
Frank Castle was born on November 15, 1979, in Queens, New York to Mario and Louisa Castle.
Later that year, Castle survived the Snap.
April 3, 2015 was day he finally returned home to New York City.
With Castle on the run, the Blacksmith began murdering anyone connected to the Central Park massacre, including Samantha Reyes and Gregory Tepper and blaming it on Punisher.
Castle went inside the St.

Castle returned to his family's home with Ray Schoonover 's stolen arsenal of weapons and looked around before sitting in at the kitchen table with a The New York Examiner newspaper featuring an article on his trial, with the x-ray of his skull as the front image.
Castle and Micro had continued to watch Dinah Madani through the window from a nearby rooftop in preparation for approaching her, noting how Madani seemed to still be mourning the death of Sam Stein.
Acting on information from Micro, Castle went to see Turk Barrett and steal a shipment of weapons from him, which Barrett supposedly got from the Greek Mob.
With a new purpose to live with, Castle once again embraced the mantle of Punisher, donning himself with a new vest and getting a haircut.

With everything in place for the incoming battle, the Punisher donned his Skull Vest and waited in the shadows while the Anvil agents had then arrived inside Micro's Hideout with their guns raised, as they all searched for their target.
Upon taking down the Gnucci Crime Family, Castle finally reached his goal by avenging his family, killing every party involved in the Central Park shootout.

nome: The Punisher: Return to New York
descricao: Castle was then flown into New York City by Dinah Madani, who put him and Amy Bendix inside her apartment for their protection.

nome: The Punisher: Serving with Billy Russo
descricao: During another deployment, Billy Russo and Castle trained together, Castle and Russo both underwent the gauntlet, in which they would walk through all their fellow marines while getting beaten down to prove their endurance as well as their physical strength, as Castle had given Russo a mocking prep talk before he went through the gauntlet first, making it to the end.
Castle was taken to Metro-General Hospital where his all of his wounds sustained while fighting the Kitchen Irish were treated and he was kept under watch by the New York City Police Department.
Quaz was an inhabitant in the Quantum Realm.
Xolum brought the Freedom Fighters two straglers, Scott and Cassie Lang.
Ramonda was born to Lumumba in the River Tribe.
Following her death, Ramonda's soul resided in the Ancestral Plane.
Shuri told Ramonda about a young girl named Assata, who chose to follow her dream of becoming a member of the Dora Milaje despite it seeming impossible due to her disability.
Ramonda welcomed her son T'Challa when he returned to Wakanda for his impending coronation after having rescued Nakia from a group of terrorists in Nigeria.
One year following T'Challa 's death, Ramonda found out about mercenaries trying to steal Vibranium.
Alexei Shostakov was born in the Soviet Union where he was raised by his father.
In 2016, Shostakov was arm wrestling several of his fellow prisoners while telling a fabricated story of how he faced off with and defeated Captain America in the 1980s.
During the Cold War, Shostakov joined the Soviet Armed Forces and was the sole recipient of their recreated Super Soldier Serum.
Shostakov eventually moved to the United States, where he got a house outside Baltimore, Maryland.
A former soldier turned international smuggler, Rick Mason developed a friendship with Natasha Romanoff after having been rescued by her from a prison in Cambodia.

nome: Robbery of the Queens Community Bank

descricao: Rocket began becoming a thief, racking up a criminal record that included thirteen counts of theft, twenty two counts of escape from his incarceration, seven counts of mercenary activity, and fifteen counts of arson.
Rocket took back the Zune, and that night, he looked at the key card he had made to escape his cell back in Arête Laboratories.
A litter of baby raccoons were taken from Earth and brought to space by a powerful being by the name of High Evolutionary, who placed them a planet named Halfworld.

As the group had reunited inside the Milano, reviewed recent events and decided that it was up to them to prevent Ronan the Accuser from destroying Xandar with his Infinity Stone, Rocket was doubtful that they would succeed, upon hearing that Quill's plan for stopping Ronan was to rob him despite the risk.
Rocket, long with the rest of the reunited Guardians of the Galaxy, attended the funeral held for Tony Stark at Stark's house.
In May 2018, Rocket and the Guardians of the Galaxy, using the Benatar, traveled in space for the insurgency of a distress call sent out by the Asgardians.
With the threat over, Rocket personally locked the High Evolutionary in a cell on Knowhere.
With the only family he ever knew gone, Rocket decided to stay with his newly found allies and became a member of the Avengers under Natasha Romanoff 's leadership.
Sometime later, the Guardians bought Knowhere from the Collector and decided to rebuild it so that it was liveable again after it had been destroyed by Thanos.
After crashing on Berhert, the Guardians began to argue about the destruction of the Milano.

Now understanding that Ego is a planet and now has to fight against him to save his allies, Rocket walked over to a Construction Drilling Vessel with Yondu Udonta, getting ready to battle along with this task.
They all then suited up in their new Time Suits, and made their way to the Quantum Tunnel.
In addition to the Quadrant, the Guardians of the Galaxy acquired a new ship with an auxiliary pod ship attached, which they dubbed the Benatar.
With the Orb now in his possession, Ronan returned to the Dark Aster and contacted Thanos to report his success.
After failing to win the Kree-Skrull War, Ronan eventually lost his high standing with the Kree Empire when the Accusers were demobilized.

Ronan was born centuries ago on the planet Hala, the ancestral homeworld of the Kree into an Imperial family which generations had fought and died in the thousand year Kree-Nova War between the Kree and Xandarians.
Years later, the Kree Empire and the Nova Empire had signed a peace treaty to end the war, which Ronan found disgusting and unacceptable.
By the Kree-Skrull War, Ronan had joined the Accusers, becoming the lead Accuser in charge of the Accuser Warships fleet.

News of Ronan's demise quickly reached Hala and incurred great outrage amongst the "purist" denizens of the Kree Empire, who marked the Guardians of the Galaxy as heretics and enemies of the Kree people.
Seeking the power that could help him achieve his goals, Ronan made an alliance with Thanos, promising to work for him in exchange for his eventual help in the destruction of Xandar.
In June, the month after the disastrous mission in Lagos, the newly appointed Secretary of State, Thaddeus Ross came to visit the Avengers Compound.
Before he left, Captain America called Sharon Carter asking her for backup.
Back at the USAF base, Wilson and Joaquín Torres prepared to leave for Germany and discussed John Walker as the new Captain America, until Wilson was approached by Bucky Barnes.
Sam Wilson was born on September 23, 1978 in Harlem to Paul and Darlene Wilson.
Wilson encouraged the creation of Solar-Battery Drones to help neighborhoods near Washington, D.C.
In May 2018, Wilson and his allies were warned by Bruce Banner that Thanos would be sending down the Black Order to Earth in order to claim the remaining Infinity Stones.

Having returned home from the United States Air Force, Wilson was hired by the Department of Veterans Affairs, with the intention of counseling the veterans who had been suffering from Post-traumatic stress disorder.
Sam Wilson joined the United States Air Force after qualifying and passing all the requirements for pararescue.

Eventually, the injured Steve Rogers was found unconscious near the ruins of the Triskelion following a fight with the Winter Soldier that had left him almost beaten to death, with a bullet wound inside his stomach.
Several weeks after the escape, Wilson went to Parkhar with Steve Rogers and Natasha Romanoff to Parkhar, Tajikistan, where the Needle had been selling Chitauri weapons.
When Joaquín Torres came out of surgery, Wilson went to visit him in the hospital.

nome: Captain America: Return to the Military
descricao: Due to his affiliation with the Avengers and his role in saving the universe from Thanos, Wilson was legally forgiven for his violation of the Sokovia Accords back in 2016.

nome: Captain America: Ruination of Thaddeus Ross' Legacy
descricao: A limousine arrived to pick up Wilson, Joaquín Torres, and Isaiah Bradley and take them to the White House.
Wilson returned to Baltimore, Maryland to meet with Isaiah Bradley again.

Maximoff, along with the rest of the Avengers, met up with Thaddeus Ross and Tony Stark who introduced them to the Sokovia Accords, a set of internationally ratified legal documents that should provide regulation and a framework for the military/law enforcement deployment of enhanced individuals which included Maximoff.
By the time the twins reached adulthood, Sokovia had become a war zone, with foreign forces led by the United States invading their streets frequently.

Wanda and Pietro Maximoff then accompanied Captain America back to the Avengers Tower and found Wanda's fear to be accurate; Tony Stark and Bruce Banner were trying to upload the consciousness of J.A.R.V.I.S.
Maximoff decided to seclude herself, and moved into a cabin in an unknown location, where she learned more about herself, and the power she possessed.
Wanda Maximoff was born in 1989 to Olek and Iryna Maximoff in Sokovia along with her twin brother, Pietro Maximoff.
Two years later, Vision began to feel an alert from the Mind Stone in his forehead, asking Maximoff to use her powers to feel it.
Despite her villainous actions, Scarlet Witch was still viewed as a hero after her death by the general public, as the Hex was covered up to be an Avengers training exercise gone wrong.
Afterwards, Maximoff was officially recruited into the Avengers and took residence in the United States.

nome: Wanda Maximoff: Secret Life in Scotland
descricao: Following her liberation, Maximoff periodically left Steve Rogers, Sam Wilson, and Natasha Romanoff to live a life with Vision in Edinburgh, Scotland.
With the expansion of the Hex, reality was transitioned into that of the 2000s, taking form as a mockumentary styled sitcom, where Maximoff, in a talking head, reflected on her actions.
The next day, Maximoff, wanting to have a funeral for Vision, tracked his body to S.W.O.R.D.

Sersi was built and programmed by Arishem the Judge, and was sent to multiple planets to protect and help evolve sentient life forms from the Deviants, powering a Celestial seed inside the planet, which would absorb the energy made from the sentient lifeforms.
Sersi and the rest of the Eternals were sent to Earth in an inactive state on the Domo.
Sersi could not move in yet with Dane Whitman because she was still working on revealing to him her and Sprite 's true nature as Eternals.
Xu Shang-Chi was born to Xu Wenwu and Ying Li and was raised at the Ten Rings Headquarters in the mountains of China.
Shang-Chi and Katy Chen rode on the bus and were soon confronted by Ten Rings agents.
Shang-Chi and Katy Chen returned to San Francisco and met their friends, Soo and John, at their favourite restaurant.
In the fall of 2024, Walters caught up with Bruce Banner, and the two went on a road trip together.
The next morning, Walters expressed her confusion for the episode still going, feeling as though it had reached a satisfying conclusion.
Jennifer Walters was born to Morris and Elaine Walters and grew up in Los Angeles, California.
At home, Walters called up Nikki Ramos, whom she lied to about being in her pyjamas and not doing anything.

Walters went to get a drink at Legal Ease Bar & Grill, where she was approached by Holden Holliway, who was very impressed by her during the trial, leading to him offering her a job at GLK&H as the head of a new division.
In 2012, Herman Schultz was employed to work for the Bestman Salvage by Adrian Toomes.
Schultz and Jackson Brice met Aaron Davis in the outskirts of Queens, where Brice enthusiastically demonstrated the Ultron Blaster Gun, straight out of Sokovia.
Shuri returned to her laboratory where she decided to try to recreate the Heart-Shaped Herb once again as she wanted to take down Namor.
Shuri was born in the late 1990s to King T'Chaka and his wife, Queen Ramonda, members of the Golden Tribe of Wakanda.
In May 2018, Shuri was tasked by her brother to help the Avengers at the Wakanda Medical Center.
Shuri decided not to attend her incoronation, instead leaving M'Baku to take the crown unchallenged.
In 2024, Shuri was told by her brother that he had fallen ill from an unknown disease and asked for her help.
Five years later, as a result of the Blip, Shuri was restored to life.
In May 2025, Shuri was working in her laboratory, building new models and a new armor.
In June 2016, along with Ramonda, Shuri greeted T'Challa when he returned to Wakanda from a mission to bring Nakia back to Wakanda as well.
Shuri told Ramonda about Assata 's decision to follow her dream of joining the Dora Milaje.

Skurge was finally given his own long-awaited opportunity to prove himself when Loki, who was currently still disguised as Odin, was ruling Asgard, banished Heimdall, claiming it to be due to neglecting his duty of protecting Asgard.
Born in Asgard to a stonemason father, Skurge had one ambition throughout his young life, to prove himself as an Asgardian warrior worthy of being remembered.

With Loki 's deception finally revealed, Skurge was removed from his position as guardian of the Bifrost Bridge and was given the task of cleaning up all the Fire Dragon 's blood which was covering almost the entire floor and walls of Himinbjorg.
Sonya Falsworth became a spy for MI6 and worked with Nick Fury, getting to know him well enough to know that he prefered to drink bourbon.
Falsworth found G'iah, who had been walking in London, and said that fighting her would be a bad idea.
Falsworth learned that Nick Fury had returned to Earth from S.A.B.E.R., so she sent two of her agents to kidnap him while he was out for a walk in Moscow.
On the evening of June 23, 2016, Parker returned home from school, he greeted his Aunt May and made mention of a "crazy car" parked outside their apartment building.
One night, Parker sneaked out of his apartment to do some work as Spider-Man.
However, before he could finish Flint Marko 's cure, Parker's Spider-Sense went into overdrive, and he stopped what he was doing.
Arriving at the Prague Main Railway Station, Spider-Man web-swung above the tracks and landed on a train.

Before long, Spider-Man found Jackson Brice as he was trying to sell weapons on the black market, some of which Spider-Man deduced were the same as from the Robbery of the Queens Community Bank the other day, with Brice demonstrating the Ultron Blaster Gun.
Peter Benjamin Parker was born in Queens, New York City on August 10, 2001.
Following the resolution of the Ambush on MV Spirit of America, Parker sat on the outskirts of New York City and watched the people being rescued before Iron Man then approached him.
With Vulture finally defeated and being taken away into custody, everything began to return to normal for Parker again, as he then returned to Midtown School of Science and Technology.
A week after returning from Europe, Parker went on a monologue in his home about how he kept his identity very guarded for the last couple of years and faced a lot of deception.

Two years later, in May 2018, en route to a school field trip to the Museum of Modern Art, Parker's Spider-Sense, which had become active again, alerted him to danger, prompting him to glance outside the school bus' window.

nome: Spider-Man: Life As a Lone Vigilante
descricao: The next day, now completely alone, Parker became fully self-sufficient, but decided to cut ties with his allies and fellow superheroes in order to protect them.
After seeing Halloween decorations in the form of a wizard, Parker thought of asking Doctor Strange for assistance and used his phone to locate the New York Sanctum.

Parker had quietly followed Ned Leeds ' Instagram, from his and Michelle Jones ' first day at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology through to their graduation, wistfully reflecting on the life he could no longer share with them.
Spider-Man spent the night sleeping behind his laptop with his letter to Michelle Jones in hand, dropping it on the table.
Eight months after being resurrected in the Blip, Parker's Spider-Sense went inactive again, and he informed Aunt May of his worries.
In 1142, Sprite and Kingo arrived in Korea to help the people with a Deviant named Kumiho.

Sprite was built and programmed by Arishem the Judge, and presumably was sent to multiple planets to protect and help evolve sentient life forms from the Deviants, powering a Celestial seed inside the planet, which would absorb the energy made from the sentient lifeforms.
Sprite and the rest of the Eternals were sent to Earth on the Domo.
In 1521, the Eternals believed they defeated the last of the Deviants around Tenochtitlan.
In 2024, Sprite lived in a small apartment with Sersi in London.
Over the next two years, Quill and the Guardians of the Galaxy welcomed Kraglin Obfonteri into the team, while helping Thor lose weight and get back into shape.
The Guardians of the Galaxy rushed Rocket to the Med-Bay in the Bowie, where they discovered that he had a kill switch inside of him.
Peter Jason Quill was born in 1980 to Meredith Quill and Ego, making him a hybrid of human and Celestial.

Following the Battle of Earth, Quill became known to the citizens of Earth, although they referred to him as "Star-Boy." A documentary about him called A Pal to All Planets: The Peter Quill Star-Boy Story was created and was available for purchase at the New Jersey AvengerCon.
In May 2018, Quill piloted the Guardians of the Galaxy in their new ship, the Benatar, to respond to a distress signal sent out by the Asgardians in their ship, the Statesman.

In 1988, when he was eight years old, Peter's mother became afflicted with terminal brain cancer that, unbeknownst to Peter, was caused by Ego, who feared that his son's growing attachment to Meredith would turn him away from his Expansion plan.

In the wake of Yondu Udonta 's death, Quill came to realize that Udonta was the father figure in his life he had always been searching for before Kraglin Obfonteri and the rest of the Guardians of the Galaxy burned the body as part of a Ravager funeral.
Martinex and Mainframe arrived to pick up Gamora, so Quill greeted them as they waited for Gamora.
By December of that year, the Guardians bought Knowhere from the Collector and decided to rebuild it so that it was liveable again after it had been destroyed by Thanos.
Living in space for twenty-six years, Quill built up a reputation as the self-proclaimed legendary outlaw "Star-Lord" and continued to work for Yondu Udonta.

As the Milano crash landed on Berhert, the Guardians of the Galaxy got out and immediately began arguing over who was responsible for the incident, with Star-Lord and Rocket both blaming each other for the crash.

Back on the Milano, Quill berated Rocket, Groot and Drax the Destroyer about their foolish attempt to rescue them from Yondu Udonta, in which they would have destroyed the ship if Undonta hadn't handed them over.
Stick was born blind, and at a relatively young age was imprisoned for ten years for an unknown crime.
Ten years later, Stick was given the mission to track down a boy known only as Black Sky.
The Defenders avenged Stick by defeating the Hand beneath Midland Circle.

Despite all of the years of fighting against the Hand, Stick eventually witnessed the destruction of the Chaste as every single member of the organization, including Shaft, was hunted down and killed by the Hand's greatest weapon, the Black Sky.

Seeking to train the perfect soldier from a young age, Stick recruited a young girl named Elektra, who had a great power within her which she did not fully understand; however, Stick secretly knew this power meant she was the Black Sky.
Stick followed Daredevil and Elektra when they tracked down one of the Hand 's secret bases where they had built a hole which had been dug hundreds of feet through New York City for unknown reasons.

When Mar-Vell, one of the top Kree scientists on Hala living undercover on the Earth, decided to turn her back on the Kree and aid the Skrulls to escape from Kree oppression, and search for a new place to live using her Light-Speed Engine, the Supreme Intelligence dispatched Yon-Rogg and Minn-Erva, two Starforce members, to capture Mar-Vell and retrieve the Light-Speed Engine.
Eventually, the Supreme Intelligence was replaced by a Kree Emperor as the head of the Kree Empire as of 2014.
Jack Duquesne was born to the wealthy Duquesne family in France, descendants of the ancient European aristocracy.
When Wilson Fisk passed his Safer Streets Initiative, Duquesne, having become an enemy of Fisk, both as a civilian and a vigilante, was arrested by the Anti-Vigilante Task Force.
Duquesne began dating Eleanor Bishop, and eventually became engaged to her, unbeknownst to Eleanor's daughter, Kate, who was away at college.
In March 2027, Duquesne started to gain public awareness as he fought publicly with swords.
Sometime after the Battle of Earth, Talos and Soren were asked by Nick Fury to impersonate him and Maria Hill respectively, as Fury was on the S.A.B.E.R.

A General for what was once the Skrulls ' military, Talos had been leading the losing side of the Kree-Skrull War ever since the destruction of their home planet Skrullos at the hands of the Kree Empire and the Accusers.

Talos' heroic sacrifice was quickly reported on by many broadcasters in the globe, and as a result humans finally learnt of the existence of a shapeshifting alien species hiding on Earth known as Skrulls.
Talos and Nick Fury made an agreement that the Skrulls would live on Earth in exchange for serving as a spy network for Fury, until they could find the Skrulls a more permanent home.
In the time following the Blip, Talos noticed a change in Nick Fury 's behavior, which was marked by Fury leaving Earth to work on S.A.B.E.R.
Antonia Dreykov was born to General Dreykov, leader of the Red Room.

In June 2016, Yelena Belova had come across the Red Dust during a mission to assassinate Oksana, and had subsequently escaped with it, General Dreykov leaded of this, and chose to recruit Taskmaster to get the Red Dust back.
Although Taskmaster was free to live her own life, she found herself falling back into what she was best at and was employed by Valentina Allegra de Fontaine to complete assassination missions.
Having obtained the Time Stone, Thanos proceeded to use the Space Stone and arrived onto Wakanda to retrieve the Mind Stone.
Thanos was born between 1013 and 1018 to A'Lars, a member of the Titans, a race of powerful, god-like beings that evolved on the planet of Titan.
With both Loki and Ronan the Accuser failing to conquer worlds and bring him the Infinity Stones, Thanos decided to take matters into his own hands.
After Thanos completed his goal in killing half of life in the universe, his actions became common knowledge, especially on Earth.

nome: Thanos: Quest for the Infinity Stones
descricao: Thanos eventually realized that there were far too many lifeforms in the universe for him to balance by himself.

In 2014, the Kree Empire signed a peace treaty with the Nova Corps, and Thanos brokered a deal with the disgraced Accuser Ronan, promising to lend him a fraction of his forces in a genocide against the Xandarians in exchange for locating the Orb for the Mad Titan.

nome: Theft of the Multiversal Engine Core

descricao: In 1520, Thena and Gilgamesh were on a boat when they found a Deviant that looked like a Kraken.

Thena was built and programmed by Arishem the Judge, and was sent to multiple planets to protect and help evolve sentient life forms from the Deviants, powering a Celestial seed inside the planet, which would absorb the energy made from the sentient lifeforms.
In 1521, During the Spanish assault on the Aztec Empire capital city, Tenochtitlan, Thena and the others Eternals were able to fight and defeat the rest of the Deviants.
Weeks later, while on the Domo, Thena, Makkari, and Druig were confused as to why the other Eternals weren't communicating with them.
In one of her missions prior to being sent to Earth, Thena and several Eternals were sent to Centuri-Six to keep the planet's citizens safe.
Thena alongside the rest of the Eternals were sent to Earth on the Domo.
One day, Thena was stuck in a state where she would draw pictures of Arishem the Judge and other things.
Thor trained Love in combat and entrusted the Stormbreaker to her.
Finally getting to be with each other, Thor and Jane Foster would spend their time together doing many different activities like rollerblading, watching movies and going to parties.
Thor joined the rest of the Avengers going to Sokovia, while Captain America organized the evacuation of all of the civilians before any fighting could have put them at risk.
Two years later, in May 2012, Frigga successfully managed to contact Loki in the Sanctuary.
Thor then brought Toothgrinder and Toothgnasher on board the Benatar.
Thor eventually found himself back on Svartalfheim with a mutant known as Deadpool.

Born during the 960s A.D., Thor had an idyllic childhood, brought up in Asgard as the most treasured son of Odin and his wife Frigga, but he was falsely led to believe that he was the firstborn child of the Allfather.

Heimdall found Thor wearing his eyepatch and noted to Thor that they had lost many people, but Thor assured him that no-one could have done more and that Odin would have been proud of Heimdall who told Thor that Odin was proud of him.

Thor was taken for questioning by Phil Coulson, who was convinced he was special forces; his remarkable fighting skills had allowed him to defeat all of Coulson's men, to which Coulson questioned if he was trained in Afghanistan or Chechnya.
Following the Snap, Thor and the remaining Avengers, along with Rocket, returned to the Avengers Compound.
In May 2010, Thor was announced to be the next ruler of Asgard by Odin, as he was about to finally enter the Odinsleep after putting it off for so long.
Before Thor caused an outburst of grief, he and Loki are stunned to see a portal from Hel appear directly in front of them.
Thor attempted to get back to the Quinjet that brought Hulk into Sakaar in the first place, avoiding the Sakaarans as he made his way towards it.

With Ultron finally defeated, and the world once again saved from its total annihilation, Thor regrouped with all of his fellow Avengers at the Avengers Compound where the newest generation of the Avengers was being trained to protect the planet.
Fearing for her safety, Thor returned to Earth and then went to finally reunite with Jane Foster to ensure that she was okay.
Thor arrived back at the Avengers Compound, where he continued to just drink while everyone else was working.
Suddenly, a loud noise rang in the team's ear as they were greeted by a heavily damaged Iron Legion drone then accused them all of being killers.

nome: Thor: War of the Nine Realms
descricao: Despite having brought Loki back to Asgard to be imprisoned, his brother's actions still loomed over Asgard.
In the aftermath of the battle, Thor attended the funeral for Tony Stark, where he watched Stark's recorded message with his family, Happy Hogan, James Rhodes and the remaining original Avengers.

Trevor Slattery grew up in Liverpool, England with his beloved mother ; his dream was always to be a world-renowned stage actor and his mother often took him to the theatre to help fuel his passion for the stage.
Slattery launched The Slattery Method to teach acting to younger stars.

Following his arrest, Slattery was incarcerated in Seagate Penitentiary, during which time Slattery's ruse made him a well known, though highly controversial, figure, with Jackson Norriss sitting down with Slattery multiple times to record a documentary.
In 2024, while doing vocal warmups before rehearsing a role, Slattery was visited by Shang-Chi and Katy Chen, who had been imprisoned by Shang-Chi's father.
In 2027, Slattery left Ta Lo and took a flight back to Los Angeles.

Down on his luck and with a serious drug addiction, Slattery was approached by Aldrich Killian, the founder of the Advanced Idea Mechanics who posed as a BBC producer, with a job offer to pay off his drug and prostitution debts.
Uatu was originally a Watcher disciple who impressed Eminence with his devotion to their mission and the fact that Uatu didn't fear sacrifice.

nome: The Watcher: Becoming His Own Person
descricao: Afterwards, as Watcher expressed pleasure at the end of another story that ended up better than it could have, he was confronted by the Incarnate, Eminence and Executioner for once more breaking his oath.
After Ultron was left in the desolate universe, Watcher lamented that he had become a program without a purpose for all eternity.

nome: The Watcher: Breaking His Oath Again
descricao: Observing a universe where the Earth was decimated by the Emergence before the Eternals could stop it, Watcher stated that this tale was the final act of a tragic story.
After his imprisonment from Maximoff, Watcher entered a new world, where the Avengers fought against Gamma Beasts created by Bruce Banner.
The Watcher became familiar with a version of Wong from a universe where the Space Stone destroyed Kamar-Taj.

Watcher soon was able to find Captain Carter at a universe where most of the present-day heroes were active during the 1600s, which as a result of a time-displaced person, many rifts threatened to tear the universe apart.
Uatu, as a Watcher, took an oath to never interfere in the affairs of the Multiverse and simply observe what went on, knowing what had happened, what was happening and what would happen all time.
During his watch, Uatu witnessed a conversation between Spider-Man and Doctor Strange in a world where Spider-Man was mentored by Norman Osborn.
The Watcher found out about a prophecy about the last Seed of Drez-Lar, which was about to be collected by Groot.

Seeing threats to their world would continue to come regardless of their own heroics, Tony Stark and Bruce Banner had both originally devised the idea for the Ultron Program as an extension of the Iron Legion to operate independently as an A.I.
Not long before Ultron's creation, he had been briefly glimpsed in the nightmarish vision by Raina along with a short sight of Loki 's Scepter while it was under experimentation.
Despite being secretly incarcerated, Ultron's actions still had consequences for the Earth 's Mightiest Heroes.
Seeking assistance in his mission, Ultron arrived in Sokovia and told a young boy named Costel to bring Pietro and Wanda Maximoff to him.
Inside the Hydra Research Base, the captured Natasha Romanoff came around, after she was knocked out.
In May 2018, the Statesman was ambushed by the Sanctuary II.
A week later, Valkyrie was met by Thor, who had returned to New Asgard.
During the 1st Millennium A.D., Brunnhilde was one of the many Valkyrie sent by Odin to drive Hela back to her prison.

Being all that remained of the Asgardian warrior maidens, Brunnhilde exiled herself to the planet Sakaar where she served the Grandmaster as one of his best acquisition specialists and slavers under the designation "Scrapper 142".
Valkyrie led Korg, Miek, and the surviving Asgardians to Earth and arrived in Tønsberg, Norway.
Hours later, the three awoke from their unconsciousness and seemingly found themselves back in Asgard.
